title: Hypno Tropes Hypnotize You
description:
You know, there are a LOT of tropes around hypnosis and mind control. Spirals, pocketwatches, hands outstretched like a zombie, pendants swaying, clickers and snaps. So many tropes that aren’t hypnotic, but your mind sort of… drifts when you experience them.

I wonder if we can amp that up a bit. Take those hypno tropes and turn the dial up on how effectively they can give you those lovely trancey feelings. Make you start to drop the second you see a spiral, anywhere. Finding yourself falling for hypnosis tropes all the time, wherever you are. Could be a little dangerous, but I bet it’ll be fun too.

This is a non-dominant and non-sexual file purely meant to make you more susceptible to the tropes surrounding hypnosis, and make you feel that a little in public and a lot in private.

Art by Rielilu.

More Erotic Hypnosis
author: Mistress Calia
